title: The Best Baked Rice and Beans
description: Chef John's baked beans and rice recipe uses pantry staples and features a foolproof method of preparing rice for a hearty dish that's comforting.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons kosher salt, or to taste
2 (15 ounce) cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Pour rice into a casserole dish; season with chili powder, salt, cumin, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and oregano. Pour in olive oil and stir until rice is thoroughly coated. Add beans, salsa, and broth; stir until evenly combined. Cover very tightly with heavy-duty aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until rice is tender, about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Remove the foil; taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Fluff with a fork and serve hot.

video.description: Discover the ultimate comfort food with Chef John's recipe for the best baked rice and beans. In this video, Chef John shares his easy and flavorful Spanish-style dish that is perfect for using basic dry and canned goods. Not only will you learn how to make delicious rice and beans, but you'll also pick up a foolproof method for cooking perfect rice every time. The combination of spices, kidney beans, salsa, and chicken broth creates a mouthwatering meal that will satisfy your taste buds. Garnish with Monterey Jack cheese, sour cream, and chopped cilantro for an extra burst of flavor. Get ready to enjoy this hearty and comforting dish that is sure to become a family favorite.
